summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a May 29, 2026 Class A meeting and Annual General Meeting. Shareholders approved four proposals: (1) increasing Class B voting rights from 20 to 200 votes per share; (2) reducing par value from $0.002 to $0.00005; (3) increasing authorized capital to 998M Class A and 2M Class B shares; (4) a related variation of Class A rights. All proposals passed with overwhelming support. The net effect is a multi-step capital restructuring that concentrates voting control in Class B shares while enabling future equity flexibility. No deal terms apply.
